waypoints.name: Reform Club
waypoints.notes: Start and finish of the wager.

waypoints.name: Charing Cross
waypoints.notes: Departure station named in the London departure.

waypoints.name: Kholby
waypoints.notes: Textual hamlet where the railway is unfinished; coordinates place it about fifty miles from Allahabad.

waypoints.name: Pillaji pagoda
waypoints.notes: Rescue site in the Indian forest; position is inferred along the Kholby to Allahabad detour.

waypoints.name: Fort Kearney
waypoints.notes: Mapped to modern Kearney, Nebraska, near the historical fort area.

waypoints.name: London terminus
waypoints.notes: Mapped to Charing Cross as a representative London rail terminus for the final arrival.

paths.title: Reform Club departure
paths.notes: Fogg and Passepartout leave the Reform Club/Savile Row area for the train out of London.

paths.title: London to Dover
paths.notes: First British railway leg toward the Channel crossing.

paths.title: Channel crossing
paths.notes: The itinerary reaches the Continent by steamboat before the Paris rail leg.

paths.title: Calais to Paris
paths.notes: The memoranda record arrival in Paris the morning after leaving London.

paths.title: Paris to Turin by Mont Cenis
paths.notes: The route table and memoranda explicitly route the train by Mont Cenis.

paths.title: Turin to Brindisi
paths.notes: Italian rail leg to the P. and O. steamer at Brindisi.

paths.title: Mongolia to Suez
paths.notes: The Mongolia leaves Brindisi and reaches Suez within the planned seven-day London-to-Suez leg.

paths.title: Suez to Aden
paths.notes: The book gives this leg as exactly 1,310 miles.

paths.title: Aden to Bombay
paths.notes: The Mongolia crosses the Arabian Sea and reaches Bombay two days ahead of the wager schedule.

paths.title: Indian railway to Kholby
paths.notes: The Great Indian Peninsula Railway route is followed through Tannah, the Western Ghats, Burhampoor, and Bundelcund until the unfinished line at Kholby.

paths.title: Elephant into the forest
paths.notes: Fogg buys Kiouni after learning that about fifty miles of railway remain unfinished; this first portion bends toward the rescue at Pillaji.

paths.title: Escape to Allahabad
paths.notes: After Aouda's rescue, Kiouni carries the party to Allahabad where the railway resumes.

paths.title: Ganges valley rail
paths.notes: The resumed railway runs through Benares, Patna, Burdwan, Chandernagore, and into Calcutta.

paths.title: Rangoon to Singapore
paths.notes: The Rangoon leaves Calcutta for Hong Kong, coaling at Singapore on the way.

paths.title: Singapore to Hong Kong
paths.notes: The book gives Singapore to Hong Kong as 1,300 miles; a storm delays the Rangoon.

paths.title: Passepartout on the Carnatic
paths.notes: Passepartout sails without Fogg; the book gives Hong Kong to Yokohama as 1,660 miles.

paths.title: Tankadere pilot-boat run
paths.notes: Fogg charters the Tankadere after missing the Carnatic; the pilot proposes Shanghai as only 800 miles away.

paths.title: American steamer to Yokohama
paths.notes: The Tankadere signals the American steamer leaving Shanghai; Fogg transfers and reaches Yokohama.

paths.title: Pacific crossing
paths.notes: The General Grant crosses the Pacific on the planned Yokohama to San Francisco leg.

paths.title: Bay ferry to Oakland
paths.notes: The party reaches the Oakland station for the transcontinental train.

paths.title: Central Pacific Railroad
paths.notes: The Central Pacific route runs from Oakland/San Francisco through Sacramento, Nevada, and Utah to Ogden.

paths.title: Union Pacific to Fort Kearney
paths.notes: The train continues by Salt Lake, Fort Bridger, Medicine Bow, and the Platte before the Sioux attack and rescue near Fort Kearney.

paths.title: Sail-sledge shortcut
paths.notes: Fix finds a sail-sledge; the book gives Fort Kearney to Omaha as at most 200 miles as the bird flies.

paths.title: Omaha to New York rail
paths.notes: The route changes trains at Omaha and Chicago, then reaches the Hudson opposite New York after missing the China.

paths.title: Hudson ferry
paths.notes: The party crosses the Hudson by ferryboat to search for an Atlantic vessel.

paths.title: Henrietta across the Atlantic
paths.notes: Fogg takes command of the Henrietta after the Liverpool steamer is missed, then diverts to Queenstown for the faster mail route.

paths.title: Queenstown to Dublin mail train
paths.notes: Queenstown mails are carried to Dublin by express trains held ready for the transatlantic steamers.

paths.title: Dublin to Liverpool packet
paths.notes: The mails are sent from Dublin to Liverpool by rapid boats, saving time over waiting for the Henrietta.

paths.title: Special train to London
paths.notes: After Fix's mistaken arrest, Fogg orders a special train from Liverpool to London.

paths.title: Late arrival at Savile Row
paths.notes: Fogg believes the wager lost and returns from the London terminus to his house.

paths.title: Final dash to the Reform Club
paths.notes: Passepartout discovers the date error; Fogg reaches the Reform Club in time.

locationFacts: Phileas Fogg's world is fixed around the Reform Club and his London house.
Passepartout is hired before any wager route begins.
deltaFacts: No mapped travel yet.
slopeFacts: Surface level; no elevation or depth movement is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: No route segment is assigned to this introductory London chapter.

locationFacts: Passepartout settles into Fogg's London household.
The chapter remains domestic and stationary.
deltaFacts: No mapped displacement.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: No path is constructed for the household setup.

locationFacts: Fogg accepts the eighty-day wager in London.
The book gives the planned world itinerary: London, Suez, Bombay, Calcutta, Hong Kong, Yokohama, San Francisco, New York, and London.
deltaFacts: The itinerary is planned but not yet traveled.
slopeFacts: No physical movement is assigned to the planning table.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The chapter supplies the spine for later route segments, but no movement has occurred.

locationFacts: Fogg leaves London at 8:45 p.m.
The initial route follows rail and steamboats through Paris, Turin by Mont Cenis, and Brindisi.
deltaFacts: The map begins the Europe-to-Suez transit.
slopeFacts: Surface and sea-level transit; no vertical component.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta uses geocoded rail and steamer waypoints from London through Brindisi and Suez.

locationFacts: The public and markets react to Fogg's departure.
The narrative is in London while the mapped party is already in transit.
deltaFacts: No new route segment starts in this chapter.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The visible route remains the London-to-Suez transit already started.

locationFacts: Fix waits at Suez for the Mongolia.
The steamer is described as running between Brindisi and Bombay via the Suez Canal.
deltaFacts: Arrival at Suez completes the first planned leg.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta is the Brindisi-to-Suez steamer segment already active from chapter 4.

locationFacts: Fogg's passport is presented at Suez.
His notebook records London, Paris, Turin, Brindisi, and Suez timing.
deltaFacts: No added route beyond the completed Suez arrival.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The chapter is documentation of route timing rather than a new path.

locationFacts: Passepartout speaks with Fix at Suez.
The Mongolia prepares to continue toward Bombay.
deltaFacts: The party is not moved to a new mapped waypoint in this chapter.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: No path starts here; the next active route starts with Suez to Aden.

locationFacts: The Mongolia crosses the Red Sea and Indian Ocean.
The Suez-to-Aden distance is given exactly in the book.
deltaFacts: The route advances from Suez through Aden toward Bombay.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ estimate uses the book distance for Suez to Aden and geocoded Aden-to-Bombay sea shaping.

locationFacts: The party lands at Bombay and boards the train for Calcutta.
Passepartout's temple incident costs him his shoes but not the train.
deltaFacts: The route leaves Bombay on the Great Indian Peninsula Railway.
slopeFacts: Surface rail route; no depth movement.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta follows the text's Indian railway route out of Bombay toward the unfinished gap.

locationFacts: The train stops at Kholby because the line is unfinished.
Fifty miles remain to Allahabad, so Fogg buys Kiouni the elephant.
deltaFacts: Rail movement changes to an elephant detour.
slopeFacts: Surface route through forest; no vertical component.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: Kholby is estimated near the text's fifty-mile gap southwest of Allahabad.

locationFacts: Kiouni carries the party through forest.
The rescue target is encountered near Pillaji.
deltaFacts: The detour bends away from a direct Kholby-to-Allahabad line.
slopeFacts: Flat surface route in the model.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The Pillaji waypoint is inferred to shape the rescue detour within the fifty-mile gap.

locationFacts: Aouda is rescued.
The party escapes by elephant toward Allahabad.
deltaFacts: The map resumes the eastward correction from Pillaji to Allahabad.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The segment is distance-constrained by the remaining portion of the fifty-mile Kholby-to-Allahabad gap.

locationFacts: The party reaches Allahabad and the railway resumes.
The train passes Benares and the Ganges valley before reaching Calcutta.
deltaFacts: The Indian crossing completes at Calcutta.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta uses geocoded Allahabad, Benares, Patna, Chandernagore, and Calcutta shaping.

locationFacts: Court proceedings briefly delay Fogg and Passepartout at Calcutta.
They still catch the Hong Kong steamer.
deltaFacts: The next sea leg starts from Calcutta.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: Chapter movement is represented by the first part of the Calcutta-to-Singapore steamer path.

chapterFacts.anchor: Rangoon in the Bay of Bengal
locationFacts: The Rangoon carries Fogg, Aouda, and Fix from Calcutta toward Hong Kong.
The book gives the Calcutta-to-Hong Kong voyage as about 3,500 miles.
deltaFacts: The map advances through the Bay of Bengal toward Singapore.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta follows a geocoded sea curve from Calcutta to Singapore.

locationFacts: The Rangoon calls at Singapore.
The book gives Singapore to Hong Kong as 1,300 miles.
deltaFacts: A storm delays the steamer before Hong Kong.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta uses the book distance and South China Sea shaping.

locationFacts: The Rangoon reaches Hong Kong.
The Carnatic's delayed boiler repair keeps the Japan connection possible.
deltaFacts: The main party arrives at Hong Kong.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta closes the Singapore-to-Hong Kong steamer leg.

chapterFacts.anchor: Carnatic missed by the main party
locationFacts: Fix prevents Passepartout from warning Fogg.
Passepartout boards the Carnatic, but Fogg and Aouda miss it.
deltaFacts: The map branches: Passepartout goes toward Yokohama while Fogg remains in Hong Kong.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta includes only Passepartout's Hong Kong-to-Yokohama branch.

locationFacts: Fogg charters John Bunsby's pilot-boat Tankadere.
The plan changes from Yokohama direct to catching the American steamer at Shanghai.
deltaFacts: The main-party branch leaves Hong Kong for Shanghai.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta uses the book's 800-mile Hong Kong-to-Shanghai distance.

locationFacts: The Tankadere endures bad weather and signals the outbound American steamer.
Fogg transfers before the steamer continues to Nagasaki and Yokohama.
deltaFacts: The main-party branch rejoins the Japan route via Shanghai.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta combines the Tankadere branch and the Shanghai-to-Yokohama steamer.

locationFacts: Passepartout wakes aboard the Carnatic without Fogg or Aouda.
He reaches Yokohama ahead of his master.
deltaFacts: Passepartout's branch continues to Japan.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta follows the separate Carnatic branch.

locationFacts: Passepartout wanders Yokohama and joins a Japanese troupe.
Fogg finds him before boarding the San Francisco steamer.
deltaFacts: The split branches reconnect at Yokohama.
slopeFacts: No new overland displacement inside Yokohama is modeled.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The relevant route is the conclusion of the Shanghai-to-Yokohama and Carnatic branches.

locationFacts: Fogg's party crosses the Pacific on the General Grant.
The route targets San Francisco for the American rail crossing.
deltaFacts: The largest ocean arc of this book runs from Japan to California.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta uses a north Pacific geodesic-shaped curve from Yokohama to San Francisco.

locationFacts: The party lands at San Francisco.
A brief city episode precedes the Pacific Railroad.
deltaFacts: The route changes from steamer to rail/ferry.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta closes the Pacific steamer arc and begins the bay transfer.

locationFacts: The train leaves Oakland station.
The Central Pacific crosses California, Nevada, and Utah toward Ogden.
deltaFacts: The American land crossing begins.
slopeFacts: Surface rail route; altitude changes are not represented in this sea-level globe model.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta uses geocoded Central Pacific waypoints via Sacramento, Reno, Elko, and Ogden.

locationFacts: The train reaches Ogden and continues east.
Passepartout attends a Mormon lecture while the train keeps moving.
deltaFacts: The route transitions from Central Pacific to Union Pacific.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta continues over the Union Pacific route.

locationFacts: The train faces a damaged bridge.
The engineer drives the train across at speed.
deltaFacts: The same rail segment continues east with an incident but no branch.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The incident is mapped along the Ogden-to-Fort-Kearney rail line.

locationFacts: The train is attacked before Fort Kearney.
Passepartout uncouples the train from the engine during the fight.
deltaFacts: The rail route is interrupted before the rescue.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: The attack is represented on the same Union Pacific segment before Fort Kearney.

locationFacts: Fogg rescues Passepartout after the Sioux attack.
The delay threatens the New York steamer connection.
deltaFacts: The rail segment reaches Fort Kearney but the schedule is broken.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta closes the Ogden-to-Fort-Kearney route.

chapterFacts.anchor: Fort Kearney to Omaha and Chicago
locationFacts: Fix arranges a sail-sledge to Omaha.
The party catches trains through Omaha and Chicago toward New York.
deltaFacts: A snow-and-wind shortcut replaces the rail gap, then rail resumes east.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta uses the book's 200-mile sledge shortcut and geocoded rail via Chicago.

locationFacts: The train reaches the Hudson after the Liverpool steamer China has left.
Fogg searches New York harbor for another vessel.
deltaFacts: The transcontinental rail route ends at Jersey City/New York.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta closes the Omaha-to-New-York rail segment and short Hudson ferry.

locationFacts: Fogg hires the Henrietta after missing the China.
The ship leaves New York, then Fogg effectively takes command for Liverpool.
deltaFacts: The final Atlantic crossing starts late from New York.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta uses a North Atlantic curve toward Queenstown.

locationFacts: The Henrietta reaches Queenstown, where Fogg takes the mail route by Dublin and Liverpool.
Fix arrests Fogg at Liverpool, then releases him too late for the apparent deadline.
deltaFacts: The route returns to London by steamer and rail.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: XYZ delta connects Queenstown, Dublin, Liverpool, and London with geocoded mail-route waypoints.

locationFacts: Fogg believes the wager lost and remains in London.
Aouda proposes marriage.
deltaFacts: No long-distance movement; the route rests at Savile Row.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: Only the small London arrival segment overlaps this chapter.

locationFacts: London society watches the wager deadline.
Fogg is presumed absent from the Reform Club.
deltaFacts: No mapped travel in this suspense chapter.
chapterFacts.xyzEstimate: No segment is assigned; the route remains in London.

locationFacts: Passepartout discovers that traveling east gained a calendar day.
Fogg reaches the Reform Club before the deadline.
deltaFacts: A final short London dash closes the route loop.
